pages.text: Moli found a tiny seed beside the quiet path. It was round, dark and cold.

translation.zh: Moli 在安静的小路旁发现了一颗小小的种子。它圆圆的、黑黑的，还有点冰凉。

simplified.en: Moli finds a small, dark seed.

pages.text: “Maybe it is sleeping,” said Moli. He carried it to the garden and made a soft bed of leaves.

translation.zh: “也许它正在睡觉。”Moli 说。他把种子带到花园，用叶子做了一张柔软的小床。

simplified.en: Moli makes a leaf bed for the seed.

pages.text: A cloud covered the moon. Moli could not see the way home, but he stayed beside the seed.

translation.zh: 云遮住了月亮。Moli 看不清回家的路，但他仍然留在种子旁边。

simplified.en: It gets dark. Moli stays with the seed.

pages.text: Then the seed began to glow. One golden leaf opened, then another. A line of light crossed the garden.

translation.zh: 这时，种子开始发光。一片金色叶子展开了，又展开了另一片。一条光路穿过花园。

simplified.en: The seed glows and makes a path of light.

pages.text: Moli followed the shining path home. In the morning, he returned with water—and a new friend was waiting.

translation.zh: Moli 沿着闪亮的小路回到了家。第二天早晨，他带着水回来，一位新朋友正在等他。

simplified.en: Moli comes back. The seed has become a friend.
